definitions.explanation: Time that has already passed, as opposed to the present or future.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧。
examples.english: To look back on the past.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忘|わす}れよう→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
{過去|かこ}⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{過去|かこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
{過去|かこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: We cannot go back to the past.

notes:
{過去|かこ} means "the past" or "former times"—the period of time that has already occurred.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {過去|かこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in the past
- {過去|かこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧: to look back on the past
- {過去|かこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: past experience
- {過去|かこ}⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧: all-time high/best ever

GRAMMAR TERM:
{過去|かこ}⟦{形|けい}→形：noentry⟧ means "past tense" in grammar studies.

TIME CONTRAST:
- {過去|かこ}: past
- ⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧: present
- ⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧: future

USAGE NOTE: {過去|かこ} is neutral in tone. For more emotional or nostalgic contexts, ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧ (long ago) may be preferred.
